description_en: Queries the details of an asset (ECS instance)
description_zh: 查询资产（ECS服务器）的详细信息
name: DescribeAssetDetailByUuids

parameters.help_en:
The UUIDs of the asset instances. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资产实例的UUID列表。多个UUID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content in the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member accounts in the resource folder.
Invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id
